title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Tier Line-up and Plan Requirements
content:
The Pocketwire Visa Debit Card comes in six tiers. Which tiers a customer can hold depends on the plan of the linked Pocketwire Personal Account. On every tier, the linked personal account must be active and its identity verification (KYC) status must be verified.

## Line-up

| Card tier | Lowest linked plan | Additional entry requirement | Physical card is metal | Validity, issue month to expiry month |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit | Pocketwire Core | none | no | 4 years |
| Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit | Pocketwire Plus | none | no | 4 years |
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | Pocketwire Prime | none | no | 4 years |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | Pocketwire Prime | personal account opened at least 180 days before the issue date | no | 4 years |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | Pocketwire Onyx | none | no | 5 years |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | Pocketwire Summit | none | yes | 5 years |

The personal account plans rank from lowest to highest as Pocketwire Lite, Pocketwire Core, Pocketwire Plus, Pocketwire Prime, Pocketwire Onyx and Pocketwire Summit. A tier's plan requirement is met by the plan named in the table or by any plan above it.

## Reading the line-up

- **Plan requirement.** A linked plan meets a tier's requirement when it is the named plan or ranks above it. A customer on Pocketwire Plus, for example, meets the requirement of Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit (Core or above) and of Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit (Plus or above). That customer does not meet the requirement of Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit, which calls for Prime or above.
- **Account age.** Only Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit adds an account-age requirement: the personal account must have been opened at least 180 days before the card's issue date. A customer on Pocketwire Prime therefore meets the plan requirement of both Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit and Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit, but can take Signature only when the account is at least 180 days old.
- **Metal.** Only the physical card of Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit is made of metal.
- **Validity.** A card's expiry month falls the validity period after its issue month. As a hypothetical example, a card issued in March on a 4-year tier expires in March four years later, and a card issued in March on a 5-year tier expires in March five years later.
